name: isArchivedDataAccessRestricted
definition: No storage bucket in the account is readable by the public: every listed bucket requires authorization to download its files.
population: the buckets the backup storage account lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A bucket list with at least one bucket in which every bucket is of a type the vendor documents as private.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms, its first implementation.

notes: Backblaze B2: bucketType allPrivate or snapshot passes, allPublic fails, any other type is not measured.
